scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: A Stage III Ravage lists Sands and Jungles. Before it starts one matching land is empty. A triggered effect during another Ravage moves an Invader into that empty land and more Invaders into a land already due to Ravage. Which lands Ravage and which Invaders participate?

Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?
What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?

For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?
For Song of Sanctity, what happens if the target land contains an Explorer, and what happens if it contains none? May the player select the Blight-removal branch while Explorers are present?
